name: Miami & Erie Canal Towpath Hiking Trail
description: Adjacent to Maumee River; runs east-west across Henry County along former Miami & Erie Canal route. Western terminus near Independence Dam State Park (Defiance/Henry county line); eastern terminus near Providence Dam Metropark (Wood County).
identity_notes: Multi-county trail. Managed by Henry County Park District on state-owned canal lands leased from Ohio.

name: Wabash Cannonball Trail
partner_agencies: Metroparks Toledo; Liberty Center Historical Society (depot restoration); Ohio Department of Natural Resources; North Country Trail Association
accessibility: Paved (Lucas County/eastern sections); cinder, gravel, dirt, grass (Henry County South Fork section)
identity_notes: Multi-county trail with two named forks: North Fork (Maumee to Montpelier, ~46 mi) and South Fork (Maumee to Liberty Center, ~18 mi). Henry County is on South Fork only (~6 mi in Washington Twp). Total length: ~64-66 miles. Former Wabash Railroad corridor; South Fork built 1855. North Country NST certified portions. Trail ends at Henry CR 7 (Pleasantview Dr) where NORTA ownership officially ends; Liberty Center depot section managed by Liberty Center/LCHS beyond that point. Multi-county entity — first staged in Henry County run; cross-ref NCT (OSM rel 11140513, DEF run). HEN-F-07 RESOLVED via NORTA trail-access page.
